content: Baselines. Since the related work BIBREF10 , BIBREF11 can be seen as the ablation cases of our method (only statistical score INLINEFORM0 with dynamic programming), we compared the full proposed method with its variants on the Test set for ablation study. In addition, we also compared our method with the longest common subsequence (LCS) based approach proposed by BIBREF12 . To the best of our knowledge, BIBREF12 is the latest related work which are designed for Ancient-Modern Chinese alignment.
